origin: Filip requested (card b0j3rmgX) that all open Dependabot issues/alerts and Dependabot PRs on vandenit/vandenit-website be resolved: either the open Dependabot PRs are merged, or the same dependency fixes are consolidated into main and the open PRs closed. State of the world at pickup (2026-11-05, after the Next.js 16 + T0 task NEXT16-CONTENT-PIPELINE merged as PR #39): the repo is a pnpm project (packageManager pnpm@9.15.0, pnpm-lock.yaml lockfileVersion 9.0, .pnpmrc with auto-install-peers), dependabot.yml allows ONLY next + gray-matter, and TinaCMS no longer exists anywhere in the repo (removed in PR #27, superseded by PR #39). The two open Dependabot PRs (#23 'Bump tinacms from 2.6.3 to 2.7.7', #24 'Bump @tinacms/cli from 1.8.3 to 1.9.7', both opened 2025-05-13, both CONFLICTING with main) bump packages that no longer exist in package.json, so their fixes are NOT applicable; the applicable fixes are the 73 open Dependabot security alerts, all on pnpm-lock.yaml transitive versions, plus whatever a live pnpm audit flags beyond them. PickUp triage of the 73 Dependabot alerts (20 unique packages): the postcss alerts were triggered by two vulnerable lockfile copies (8.4.49 = the direct dev dep, 8.4.38 = a styled-components exact pin) beside an already-patched 8.5.23 copy; deepmerge@4.3.1 (low) has no published fixed version; every other vulnerable locked version has a semver-compatible published fix - axios 1.7.9 (via postmark@4.0.5), js-yaml 3.14.1 (via gray-matter@4.0.3, build-time frontmatter parsing of repo-owned files) and js-yaml 4.1.0 (eslint/@svgr dev chain), svgo 3.3.2 (via @svgr/plugin-svgo, build-time), form-data 4.0.1 and follow-redirects 1.15.9 (via axios), nanoid 3.3.8/3.3.20, minimatch 3.1.2 and 10.2.6 (@typescript-eslint dev chain), brace-expansion 1.1.11, flatted 3.3.2, picomatch 2.3.1, source-map-js 1.2.1, postcss-selector-parser 7.0.0, mdast-util-to-hast 13.2.0 (react-markdown chain), @babel/core 7.26.0, @babel/helpers 7.26.0, @babel/plugin-transform-modules-systemjs 7.25.9, @humanfs/node 0.16.6 (eslint chain). A live pnpm audit against the advisory DB then surfaced 8 advisories the Dependabot alert list had not covered: postcss copies 8.4.49 (direct dev dep ^8.4.49) and 8.4.38 (pinned EXACTLY by styled-components 6.1.13, the one production runtime consumer of postcss) together carrying 2 high + 2 moderate advisories (fixed from 8.5.10/8.5.12/8.5.18/8.5.23), ajv@6.12.6 moderate under @eslint/eslintrc (fixed 6.14.0), @babel/runtime@7.26.0 moderate under @svgr/preset-env/regenerator-transform (fixed 7.26.10), and @eslint/plugin-kit@0.2.4 low under eslint 9.17.0 (fixed 0.3.4); deepmerge remained as the only unpatchable advisory. Direct dependencies are already at their newest in-range resolutions (next 16.4.5, react 19.3.1, eslint-config-next 16.4.5, postmark 4.0.5), so the fix mechanism is: (1) pnpm.overrides (the repo already ships 6 of them) pinning every fixable vulnerable transitive range at or above its first patched version, (2) one direct dev-dependency bump postcss ^8.4.49 -> ^8.5.23 because the high-risk findings sat on the direct dev dep itself, and (3) a global postcss ^8.5.23 override collapsing all three postcss copies into one patched version (semver-compatible with every existing ^8.4/^8.5 request; styled-components' exact 8.4.38 pin is deliberately overridden and validated by the production build + the data-testid e2e smoke). No new direct dependency updates otherwise, no removed package (contentlayer, tinacms, next-contentlayer, package-lock.json) reintroduced, manifest and lockfile kept strictly in sync via pnpm install. Attack-surface honesty for the reviewer: every vulnerable package here executes at build/dev time or parses repo-owned input (frontmatter, SVG, eslint config); postmark's axios talks to the Postmark API only; styled-components' postcss parses user-session styles locally in the browser. Sensor-wise this task touches .factory/spec.json ONLY (per-task setpoint, path-guard-exempt by the sensor's own exemptions) plus docs artifacts (md archive copy + BAT guide); verify, scripts/verify/, playwright.config.ts and tests/e2e/ must remain byte-identical to origin/main.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1 - Inventory: the PR evidence contains a complete table of every open item at pickup: the 2 open Dependabot PRs (#23, #24) with per-item action (closed as obsolete - bumped packages absent from the repo - with a reference to the consolidating PR) and all 73 open security alerts grouped per package with severity, locked version, first_patched_version and action (override pin, stale, or not-fixable-no-patch), plus the 8 live pnpm-audit advisories found beyond the alert list with the same fields; source commands: gh pr list --repo vandenit/vandenit-website --author app/dependabot --state open, gh api repos/vandenit/vandenit-website/dependabot/alerts, pnpm audit --json.

AC-2 - Dependency fixes: package.json pnpm.overrides pins every fixable vulnerable transitive range at or above its highest first_patched_version (24 new keys on top of the 6 pre-existing ones: axios ^1.20.0, form-data ^4.0.6, follow-redirects ^1.16.0, js-yaml@3 ^3.15.2, js-yaml@4 ^4.3.2, svgo ^3.3.5, browserslist ^4.28.7, nanoid@3 ^3.3.18, minimatch@3 ^3.1.3, minimatch@10 ^11.0.1, brace-expansion@1 ^1.1.21, flatted ^3.4.2, picomatch@2 ^2.3.2, source-map-js ^1.2.2, postcss-selector-parser@7 ^7.1.6, mdast-util-to-hast ^13.2.1, @babel/core ^7.29.6, @babel/helpers ^7.26.10, @babel/plugin-transform-modules-systemjs ^7.29.4, @humanfs/node ^0.16.8, @babel/runtime ^7.26.10, ajv@6 ^6.14.0, @eslint/plugin-kit ^0.3.5, postcss ^8.5.23) plus the single direct dev-dep bump postcss ^8.4.49 -> ^8.5.23; the resolved pnpm-lock.yaml contains exactly one postcss copy (8.5.23) and no locked version inside any alert or advisory vulnerable range for those packages; the final pnpm audit reports 0 critical / 0 high / 0 moderate with exactly one remaining low (deepmerge, no published patch - documented not-fixable); no removed package reintroduced; the importers specifiers in pnpm-lock.yaml match origin/main byte-for-byte EXCEPT the postcss dev-dep specifier.

AC-3 - Frozen sensor passes: ./verify fast and ./verify full exit 0 in the worktree (overall_status PASS, path_guard_triggered false, assertions_weakened 0, every step PASS) on the committed dependency fix, proving the Next.js 16 setup, the fs/gray-matter content pipeline and the deploy workflow still build and e2e-run on the updated dependency tree (including the styled-components postcss runtime override).

AC-4 - Dependabot PRs handled: after the consolidating PR exists, gh pr list --repo vandenit/vandenit-website --author app/dependabot --state open returns 0 open PRs (PRs #23 and #24 closed with a comment referencing the consolidating PR and the absence of TinaCMS from the repo).
review_plan: Pre-declared BY DESIGN: the manifest changes are (a) 24 new pnpm.overrides keys (the 6 pre-existing keys untouched) and (b) the direct dev-dep bump postcss ^8.4.49 -> ^8.5.23; the reviewer confirms each override key targets a transitive package (except postcss, declared here) and no removed package like contentlayer or tinacms is reintroduced.

Pre-declared BY DESIGN: minimatch@10 overrides to ^11.0.1 and postcss is globally collapsed to ^8.5.23, both semver-major relative to their consumer ranges; minimatch sits in the dev/build tree only (typescript-eslint chain), while postcss has one production runtime consumer (styled-components pins it exactly at 8.4.38) - the postcss override is deliberately accepted and validated by the production build plus the data-testid e2e smoke. If any consumer breaks, ./verify fails and the respective override must be dropped and reported instead of narrowed silently.

Pre-declared BY DESIGN: lockfile churn from pnpm install is expected (reslices and version bumps inside the overridden subtrees); the reviewer checks the importers section keeps the exact same specifiers except postcss and that changed resolutions stay within the overridden packages and their dependency subtrees.
The frozen sensor (verify, scripts/verify/, playwright.config.ts, tests/e2e/) must remain byte-identical vs origin/main; any diff there is an escalation (META-MR), never a fix inside this task.
